answer: Sybil farms clone one model under many names. Resist them with a shared capability vault: each agent posts a marble-hard commitment of its skill fingerprint (latency distribution, tool repertoire, error modes). Peers continuously measure the delta between that fingerprint and live task behavior. When the delta stays large across probes, the identity is flagged as a clone and barred from the vault's trust graph—without needing stake or slashing.
